title: Concept of Possession
theory:
1 Noun ending with "s", use apostrophe (')
       2 Noun ending without "s", use apostrophe ('s)
       3 In case of things, objects, ideas etc. use preposition of
       4 Do not use 's with possessive adjective and possessive pronoun.
       5 's is used with expressions of time, distance and value.
       6 Add 's to the last word of a compound noun.
       7 In case of joint possession, add 's to the last noun.
       8 In case of separate possession, add 's to each noun.
       9 Use 's with an indefinite pronoun to show possession.
      10 When "else" comes after an indefinite pronoun, the 's is added to "else", not to the
           pronoun.
